item.title: Darkest Moments In Gaming: Earthbound
item.description: You knew at some point Giygas was gonna show up. I could talk about this thing until the cows come home, but i'll try to limit it to one post. Giygas is the embodiment of out of no where horror. The game is all sunshine, rainbows, and quirked up kids beating up hippies, packed with all sorts of pop culture references and nostalgic vibes.
